title: glottis echinata
intro: Glottis echinata, commonly known as the hedgehog flower or devil's head, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is said to have various health benefits, including its ability to help lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Glottis echinata include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, which make it useful for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Glottis echinata include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
